text:
marie (docs): Hey team — opened a docs PR for adding nebula-3b to the model catalog. Main things: supported hardware notes, updated long-context limits, new benchmark numbers, and a short migration note for users on older orion variants. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infer-docs/pull/482

sam (eng): thanks — skimmed. Bench numbers look plausible but we should replace the single-line throughput entry with a small table or explicit numbers per config. I ran a quick perf on a nodepool w/ A100-80GB: 32 request/s @512 tokens (batch=8). On T4 it's ~9 req/s.

leo (ml): FYI on quant: nebula-3b performs best with 4-bit PTQ currently; add compatibility note that int8 on GPU has regressions w/ quick-kernel for rotary. Also add CPU-fallback behavior: we auto-fallback to CPU with a warning, but latency will spike — add sample warning text.

marie (docs): good call. I'll add a short "quant & compatibility" section and a one-line CPU fallback alert. For bench table do we want separate rows for (A100-80GB, A10, T4) or just A100/T4?

sam (eng): prefer A100 / A10 / T4. A10 numbers are important for Dedicated customers. For numbers: A100: 32 r/s @512 tok, A10: 18 r/s, T4: 9 r/s. Also add tail latency p95: A100 ~85ms per token, T4 ~230ms per token (approx).

nora (product): Can we also add a migration snippet for customers pinned to orion-xl or zephyr-mini? They need guidance if they want to switch to nebula-3b for cost reasons. Suggest a minimal SDK example + note about model aliasing and rollout policy.

marie (docs): drafting SDK snippet now. Will include streaming example + safe fallback. Draft snippet:```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
# streaming example
resp = client.chat.stream(model="nebula-3b", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this"}], max_tokens=256)
for chunk in resp:
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```
We should check if this code uses the latest SDK names — Sam, Leo, confirm?

sam (eng): snippet looks good. small nit: client.chat.stream returns an iterator of events, include error handling for fallback:```python
try:
    for chunk in resp:
        print(chunk.text, end="")
except ClientFallbackError:
    # warn and retry without streaming or with a smaller model
    ...
```

leo (ml): Add a short compatibility note: "nebula-3b is ABI-compatible with runtime >= 2.4.0; older runtimes may require a model-conversion step (see toolchain link)." Also add quant profiles: default=ptq4, alt=int8-experimental.

marie (docs): ok I'll add those. Also found two broken links in the PR to internal benchmark images — will fix paths. Want to surface a changelog entry for model-catalog v2.7.0 to mention "new nebula models + long-context clarifications".

sam (eng): one more ops item: add a console note about canary rollout sample config: small YAML showing canary=10% route to nebula-3b with fallback to orion-xl. Keeps Dedicated customers from flipping instantly.

nora (product): QA request: can we add a small prompt test in the docs that catches long-context truncation? e.g., feed a 12k token doc and assert the model returns a short summary and not an error. This will be used in the quality checks.

marie (docs): good idea — I'll add a short prompt + expected-behavior section.

docs-bot: PR updated by marie. Changes: added bench table, compatibility notes, SDK streaming snippet, migration guidance, fixed links.

sam (eng): I'll run a quick perf job to re-verify numbers and paste CSV here when done.

marie (docs): thanks! tagging @qa for a quick smoke. If no blockers I'll merge midday Friday. :thumbsup:

nora (product): approved from product side — minor wording request on migration paragraph (clarify "pinning" semantics).

marie (docs): noted and updated. Final commit pushed. Marking this thread resolved unless anyone has last-minute issues.

sam (eng): CSV results attached in PR. numbers match within 5%. :ok_hand:

leo (ml): Approved for ML compat.

marie (docs): merging in 10m. Thanks all! :sparkles:
